newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks end at record highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks end at record highs.

text.p: A broad rally pushed major U.S. stock indexes to record closing highs on Wednesday.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed unofficially up 72 points, or 0.9 percent, to 8259. It topped the gauge's previous closing high set July 30 at 8254.89.
The Nasdaq composite hit its sixth-consecutive record closing high, gaining unofficially nine points to 1630.
The S&P 500 rose unofficially eight to 960, topping its previous mark of 954.29 set July 31.
